name: GEVS Level 3 — door-open (stateful interactables)
description: door_01 state machine (INTERACTABLES_SPEC.md, spatial layer 5): setGoal door_01.open from the room center → she walks to the door's resolved standing point, faces the door, plays the open prompt; on COMPLETION the engine applies the sets transition — the door mesh rotates to the open mesh_rotation ([0,-1.57,0] ≈ 90°), the door's nav obstacle is disabled (states.open.obstacle false), the doorway route (1.5,-1.5)→(-2.3,-3.4) flips from blocked to clear, and the transition is journaled. Evidence comes from the door probes merged into the telemetry samples (state / rotationDeg / nav enabled / route-clear / journal) plus the planner telemetry (goal/phase/promptLog). Assertions: state was closed BEFORE (fail-before), state is open AFTER, mesh rotated ≥80°, nav obstacle disabled, doorway route blocked-then-clear, transition journaled, goal completed, stream live.

assertions.basis: fail-before: the door starts closed (manifest initial state 'closed')
the sets transition applied: state machine says 'open' after completion
open mesh_rotation [0,-1.57,0] ≈ 90° rotation of the door mesh from closed [0,0,0]
states.open.obstacle false → the door's nav obstacle is disabled
fail-before: while closed, the route through the doorway is blocked
once open, the same route is clear (paths can route through the doorway)
the closed→open transition is journaled (spec: state transitions journaled in telemetry)
the interaction actually completed — sets applies on COMPLETION (arrival + prompt finished), never on cancel/timeout
